title: 被动结构

examples.en: The classroom is cleaned every day.
The window was broken by Tom.

guess.question: 这两句话的主语（教室、窗户）是“做动作的人”还是“承受动作的人”？

options.text: 承受动作的人——教室被打扫、窗户被打碎
options.feedback: 对！主语是“被怎么样的那个”，这就是被动语态。

options.text: 做动作的人——教室在打扫、窗户在打碎
options.feedback: 不对——那是主动语态，比如 We clean the classroom。
不对——主语就是被动作影响的那个，正是承受者。

rule.rule: 主语是动作的承受者时用被动语态，强调“被怎么样”
signals: 句子里不出现做动作的人
rule.formula: be + 过去分词（be 随时态和人称变化）

anchors.en: Rice is grown in the south of China.
anchors.note: “稻米”不是自己种的，是被种的

anchors.en: The letter was written by my sister.
anchors.note: by my sister 点出执行者

trap.wrong: The window is break by him.
trap.right: The window is broken by him.
trap.why: be 后面要接过去分词 broken，不能接动词原形 break。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——记住被动的两块砖：be 动词 + 过去分词，缺一不可。

options.distractor: 英语是被说的，不是自己说

check.explanation: 英语是“被说”的，用 is spoken。
汽车是“被制造”的，复数用 are made。

options.text: The homework is done by me every day.
The homework is do by me every day.
options.distractor: be 后要接过去分词 done

options.text: The homework is did by me every day.
options.distractor: did 是过去式，这里要过去分词 done

options.text: The homework is doing by me every day.

check.explanation: 被动结构：is + 过去分词 done。
